4158.title: Unresolved hooks repeatedly reschedule removal
4158.rootCauseOneLine: Unknown hook cancellation preserves the pending operation while removal schedules another fixed-delay retry.
4158.proposedFix: Define safe explicit recovery and stop automatic retries while hook outcome remains unresolved.
4158.caveats: Server lifecycle reproduced twice with RPC responses modeling memory loss; no physical restart or fleet data verified. Full regression patch is inline in report.
